snippets.body: game:GetService('${1:ServiceName}')
${1:parent}:WaitForChild('${2:ChildName}')
${1:parent}:FindFirstChild('${2:ChildName}')
${1:template}:Clone()
${1:instance}:Destroy()

local part = Instance.new('Part')
part.Parent = ${1:workspace}
part.Position = Vector3.new(${2:0}, ${3:5}, ${4:0})
part.Size = Vector3.new(${5:4}, ${6:1}, ${7:4})

local TweenService = game:GetService('TweenService')
local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(${1:1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local tween = TweenService:Create(${2:object}, tweenInfo, {${3:Position} = ${4:Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)}})
tween:Play()

local DataStoreService = game:GetService('DataStoreService')
local DataStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore('${1:PlayerData}')

local function saveData(player, data)
	local success, err = pcall(function()
		DataStore:SetAsync('player_' .. player.UserId, data)
	end)
	return success
end

local function loadData(player)
	local success, data = pcall(function()
		return DataStore:GetAsync('player_' .. player.UserId)
	end)
	if success then return data end
end

local function setupLeaderstats(player)
	local leaderstats = Instance.new('Folder')
	leaderstats.Name = 'leaderstats'
	leaderstats.Parent = player

	local ${1:Cash} = Instance.new('IntValue')
	${1:Cash}.Name = '${1:Cash}'
	${1:Cash}.Value = ${2:0}
	${1:Cash}.Parent = leaderstats
end

game:GetService('Players').PlayerAdded:Connect(setupLeaderstats)

local UserInputService = game:GetService('UserInputService')

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then return end
	
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.${1:E} then
		${2:-- do something}
	end
end)

local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {${1:ignore}}
raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.FilterType.Exclude

local raycastResult = workspace:Raycast(${2:startPosition}, ${3:direction}, raycastParams)

if raycastResult then
	print('Hit:', raycastResult.Instance)
else
	print('No hit')
end

local Tool = script.Parent
local activated = false

local function onActivated()
	if activated then return end
	activated = true
	
	${1:-- tool code}
	
	task.wait(${2:0.5})
	activated = false
end

Tool.Activated:Connect(onActivated)

local ScreenGui = Instance.new('ScreenGui')
ScreenGui.Name = '${1:GuiName}'
ScreenGui.Parent = ${2:game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer:WaitForChild('PlayerGui')}

local Frame = Instance.new('Frame')
Frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, ${3:300}, 0, ${4:200})
Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
Frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
Frame.Parent = ScreenGui

local Label = Instance.new('TextLabel')
Label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0)
Label.Text = '${5:Hello World}'
Label.TextSize = ${6:24}
Label.Parent = Frame

local debounce = false

local function ${1:functionName}()
	if debounce then return end
	debounce = true
	
	${2:-- code}
	
	task.wait(${3:1})
	debounce = false
end

local CollectionService = game:GetService('CollectionService')

for _, instance in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged('${1:TagName}')) do
	${2:-- do something}
end
